actions.label: Wingtip Lights ON
actions.description: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SERVO: drive SERVO8 to 1900 us (SERVO8_MAX). Requires SERVO8_FUNCTION to be 0 (Disabled) or an RCINn pass-through - AP_ServoRelayEvents::do_set_servo() refuses any other function with 'Channel 8 is already in use'.

actions.label: Wingtip Lights OFF
actions.description: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SERVO: drive SERVO8 to 1100 us (SERVO8_MIN). Set SERVO8_TRIM to 1100 as well so the lights boot OFF rather than to the 1500 us midpoint.

actions.label: Gripper Release
actions.description: Open the gripper (DO_GRIPPER instance 1, action RELEASE)

actions.label: Gripper Grab
actions.description: Close the gripper (DO_GRIPPER instance 1, action GRAB)

actions.label: PosXY GPS Enable
actions.description: Enable GPS as EK3 PosXY source (DO_AUX_FUNCTION Scripting4 = LOW). Needs the EK3 PosXY switch Lua script on the aircraft.

actions.label: PosXY GPS Disable
actions.description: Disable GPS as EK3 PosXY source (DO_AUX_FUNCTION Scripting4 = HIGH). Needs the EK3 PosXY switch Lua script on the aircraft.
